variables.title: Instance-imbalance analysis
variables.log_evidence: The highlighted logs come from ${truth.finding} itself: peer instances remained healthy. Only this instance ran hot, so it's an outlier rather than a fleet-wide load problem.

demonstration.narration: I'll open this host's Logs tab to see what it recorded about its peers while it ran hot.
demonstration.reasoning: A resource spike alone does not prove customer impact or causation. Matching its entity and timing to another observable signal tests the relationship.
